appearances.name: Gaslight District · Hommage · Melancholy Hill
appearances.identity: Clothing-only homage to Melancholy Hill's visible outfit in the official figurine reference: a snug rusty-brown segmented wrap suit, cream rolled cowl collar, oversized flared brown wrist cuffs, dark-brown ankle gaiters. Fit the suit to Ribbit's very long thin green limbs and slim torso, leaving four green fingers and three webbed toes exposed. His pale belly becomes a pale inset shirt panel, pink bow tie on the cowl. A small orange fabric crest tied behind the eye mounds echoes Mel's swept orange tuft without giving Ribbit a human face or hiding either huge white eye. Preserve bright lime frog skin, both black wedge pupils, rosy cheeks and frog smile. Use the historical Gummigoo reference only for the brown worn-leather palette and Encore ink style, not its cowboy hat, long coat, snout or tail. No weapon, no stitches on skin, no glowing eyes.

appearances.name: Gaslight District · Résident · Gardien des écluses
appearances.identity: Original canal lock keeper in the Gaslight District. Keep Ribbit's natural lime frog body and very long slender legs. Worn dark petrol-green knee-length dock coat with ochre edging and rolled cuffs, rust-red neck scarf with pink bow tie pinned at front, brown leather belt with a large simple brass key and small warm-yellow glass lantern fixed to hip; small battered brown brim hat fitted between the eyes, with a brass band; dark slate cropped trousers. Bare green four-finger hands and three-toed webbed feet, brown ankle straps. Lantern yellow remains inside glass with no glow, no floating effects. Modest wear on clothing, no gore. Costume based on the second reference but no crocodile head, snout, tail, spines or cowboy anatomy.

appearances.name: Gaslight District · Fusion · Têtard des brumes
appearances.identity: Genuinely reimagined Ribbit as a supernatural brackish-canal amphibian, one solid opaque body. Olive/lime frog face with the same two enormous white wedge-pupil eyes, round pink cheeks and broad smile; longer low-backed teal-green tadpole torso, one broad finned tail curling behind him, slim long four-fingered arms and powerful folded hind legs with three wide webbed toes. Subtle mossy skin patches, cream rib-like belly plates shaped as a small vintage lantern cage with warm yellow opaque inset glass at center, copper rib collars around the torso as organic structural features. Two soft rose gill frills at throat reinterpret Ribbit's pink bow. Small ragged rust fabric waist sash and brass ankle rings. Body design itself changed, not a costume on standard Ribbit. Use second-reference patinated metals, ragged coastal detail and green/ochre palette, but no crocodile snout, claws, pirate hat or weapons. Tail entire inside frame, no mist or separate glow despite the name.
